name: spoke-kit
description: Claude intelligence layer for ESA Ecology design-system spokes. Ships the component-first discipline (skill + PreToolUse hook enforcing the Ecology esa-* -> Beacon -> bcn- lookup order), the accessibility discipline (skill + PreToolUse hook enforcing deterministic a11y practices — positive tabindex, missing alt, suppressed focus rings, keyboard-unreachable roles — without prescribing patterns), the hub-state discipline (SessionStart hook warning when the sibling ecology checkout has WIP that the spoke's file: symlinks are serving live, plus the /ship hub gate that blocks deploying it — escape ship-wip-approved:), the /spoke-init scaffolding command, and the spoke pre-commit review skill. Single source of truth lives in the ecology hub repo; do not copy these files into spokes.
